audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1 and 4 disagreed with the packet chart (Skill, Riven, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn) and with the page's own whys.
audit.why: whys[0] ends 'neither of you should win a clean trade yet' — that is Skill, and the chart rendered Riven. whys[1] says her level-2 spike 'beats a mana-starved, shield-less Ornn' — that is Riven, and the chart rendered Skill. The two rows were simply swapped. whys[4] says 'you own every level-6 all-in' while the chart rendered Riven.
audit.corrected: Row 0 Riven -> Skill (5/10), row 1 Skill -> Riven (3/10), row 4 Riven -> Ornn (6/10), in BOTH layers as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'Riven: Ki Burst online, level 6, first item' — level 2 is her actual spike and it was not listed, and Blade of the Exile was never named or costed.
audit.why: The page's own text identifies level 2 as her window (whys[1], spikes[0]) but the spike list did not. Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s — it more than halves across ranks, so a level-6 read tells you nothing about the level-11 or level-16 one.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read: Riven — level 2 with Broken Wings and Ki Burst, Blade of the Exile at 6 (120s). Ornn — level 3, Iceborn Gauntlet, 2-item window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: none of Riven's abilities were named — the page said 'her Q-dash', 'W stun', 'her E dash'. Three concrete mechanics were absent.
audit.why: (1) Broken Wings is a flat 13s for the whole three-cast cycle and 'the third hit knock[s] back nearby enemies' — a displacement the page never warned about, and the reason standing next to her third cast hands her free spacing. (2) Runic Blade: 'Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges' — her damage lives in the autos BETWEEN casts, so a knockup mid-combo denies the charges rather than just the dash. (3) Her dashes are tiny — Broken Wings 275, Valor 250, Ki Burst 260 — so a magma pillar dropped in the path genuinely takes her exit. Cooldowns never stated: Ki Burst 11s at rank 1 to 7s maxed, Valor 10s to 6s.
audit.corrected: All five named with ranges and cooldowns; the third-cast knockback, the Runic Blade auto-weave and the short-dash/pillar interaction added.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said 'Her engage CC. Brittle-tank it.' with no numbers.
audit.why: Valor at 10s rank 1 is the block that eats Ornn's committed damage, and it is a shorter cooldown than Ki Burst — so 'wait for the stun' is the wrong read; you bait the block.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries Ki Burst 260/11s/7s, Valor 10s, and Broken Wings' flat 13s with the third-cast knockback.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] tells the player to 'add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind', and breakdown.late says 'anti-heal stays core'. Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit.
audit.why: This is inherited template text from a sustain matchup. It sends the player to buy Grievous Wounds against a champion with zero heal, spending gold that should go to armour or health.
audit.corrected: report[8] now says Thornmail is fine for the armour but names that Riven has no healing to cut; breakdown.late drops the anti-heal instruction and fixes the male pronoun.
sources: kit: Riven P/Q/W/E/R contain no heal or lifesteal clause

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Two of six lane rules repeated the trading section word for word.
audit.corrected: They now carry the Runic Blade charge-denial and the short-dash pillar block.

notes: One outright wrong instruction fixed: the page told the player to buy anti-heal because 'his healing fights your grind'. Riven has no heal, lifesteal, or drain anywhere in her kit — this was inherited template text from a sustain matchup and it was costing gold. Corrected in both report[8] and breakdown.late. Best new mechanics: the third cast of Broken Wings knocks back (a displacement the page never mentioned), and Runic Blade means her damage is in the autos between casts, so a knockup mid-combo denies charges rather than merely interrupting a dash. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: whether Volcanic Rupture's grounding stops Broken Wings or Valor mid-cast (grounding is a derived flag not present in Riot's Volcanic Rupture text), whether the third Broken Wings knockback can interrupt Searing Charge, and whether Wind Slash is blocked by terrain despite its projectile flag.
